description: Where are you starting? (F225; framework .planning/research/bmuz-vision/entry-research.md): one question about the game (a second only when something already exists), the engine reads what was shared onto DISCOVER.md's shelves and works out the gap map and where to start — any stage, any step — for the creative to confirm, then moves into that stage. The labels describe the game, never the person.

steps.description: Where's your game right now? (and, when something exists, what you want from this pass)
